watermarked:
the show! Many people had questions, some asked for more time, and some just wanted a chat and to meet others in similar situations.

So, as well as the physical aspects, I thought it would be good to share some of the mental and emotional aspects of thyroid conditions.

So many people have come to me, in the last few years, with a huge range of issues, such as depression, anxiety, lack of motivation, mood swings, irritability, brain fog and fatigue. Some people even have a sense of isolation, or they feel like they are not "themselves" anymore. These symptoms are often attributed to their thyroid condition.

In this blog I want to share some of the emotional and mental impacts of thyroid conditions and also offer some simple tips to help with them.
